findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: call_service, news_search, web_scrape, web_scrape_batch, email_verify · Private data: find_service, ip_lookup, web_scrape, sec_filings, token_verdict, audio_transcribe · Public sink: email_verify, token_verdict, audio_transcribe · Destructive: find_service, call_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: call_service, news_search, web_scrape, web_scrape_batch, email_verify · Private data: find_service, ip_lookup, web_scrape, sec_filings, token_verdict, audio_transcribe · Public sink: email_verify, token_verdict, audio_transcribe · Destructive: find_service, call_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
